name: pr-watch
description: Watches gate, reviews and post-merge pipelines of Azure DevOps and GitHub pull requests

ado.title: Azure DevOps
ado.description: Watch Azure DevOps pull requests (az CLI)

githubHosts.title: GitHub hosts
githubHosts.description: Comma-separated hosts to accept; add your GitHub Enterprise host (gh must be logged in there)

details.title: Failure details and stages
details.description: Fetch the build timeline (ADO) and check annotations (GitHub); one extra call per build

currentBranch.title: Current branch PR
currentBranch.description: On session start, watch the open PR of the current branch

maxRows.title: PRs in the band
maxRows.description: How many PRs the band shows before collapsing the rest into a +N more button that opens the full list

notify.title: System notifications
notify.description: off, important (failures, changes requested, pending approvals, merges, finished deploys) or all (every state change)

tasks.title: Spec tasks
tasks.description: Read docs/prd task files (spec-driven-dev) to link PRs to tasks, show plans in the overview and watch PRs of tasks in review
